warning.prompt: A menacing electrical weapon charging: a thin rising capacitor whine with rapid red-hot sparking ticks, crescendo then abrupt stop. Dark science fiction, one continuous build, no initial impact, no voice, no music.

burst_tell.prompt: A heavy machine gun bolt racks with a cold sharp metallic clack, followed by an ominous short rising servo whine. One ready-to-fire warning, close and dry, no shots, no music, no voice.

shock.prompt: A violent high-voltage lightning discharge: one sharp electrical crack, thick crackling arc and short bass thud, with a very brief sizzling tail. Close and punchy science fiction weapon, no voice, no music.

shot.prompt: One single heavy belt-fed machine gun shot, a deep dry concussive report with a short metallic bolt clatter. Absolutely one shot only, no burst, no voice, no music.
